9-Day Greece Island Tour: Naxos, Santorini & Crete
summary:
The 9-Day Greece Tour travels from Athens through Naxos and Santorini before continuing to Crete, combining the capital with three islands that each have their own character. Begin at the Acropolis and historic Athens, then slow the pace in Naxos with its beaches, villages and Cycladic landscape. Santorini follows with its volcanic caldera, while Crete brings a deeper archaeological and cultural dimension to the final part of the journey.
Travel is arranged from April to October around seasonal ferry schedules. The program includes selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, speed ferry tickets, airport and port transfers, and the scheduled sightseeing detailed in the itinerary.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Athens
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Athens International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Half Day Athens City tour
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy a half-day guided tour of Athens, including the Acropolis of Athens, Acropolis Museum, and Parthenon. Continue past the Parliament, Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, Presidential Palace, Panathenaic Stadium, Temple of Olympian Zeus, and Arch of Hadrian. Afternoon at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Ferry to Naxos
itinerary.text:
Breakfast and check-out from the hotel. Transfer to the port for your ferry to Naxos.
Arrival and transfer to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Naxos.

itinerary.title: Free Day in Naxos
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Free day in Naxos, the largest island of the Cyclades.
Enjoy sandy beaches, traditional villages, fertile valleys, and scenic mountain landscapes.
Explore ancient ruins, local shops, and authentic Greek culture throughout the island.
Overnight in Naxos.

itinerary.title: Ferry to Santorini
itinerary.text:
Breakfast and check-out from the hotel. Transfer to the port for your ferry to Santorini.
Arrival and transfer to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Free Day in Santorini
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy a free day in Santorini with an optional cruise to Nea Kameni, Palea Kameni, and Thirassia. Later, explore Fira and enjoy the island’s famous caldera views. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Santorini to Crete by Ferry
itinerary.text:
Breakfast and check-out from the hotel. Transfer to the port for your ferry to Crete.
Arrival and transfer to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Crete.

itinerary.title: Free Day in Crete
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Enjoy a free day in Heraklion, the capital of Crete. We recommend visiting the famous Palace of Knossos and the Heraklion Archaeological Museum. Overnight in Heraklion.

itinerary.title: Departure from Athens
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Athens Airport according to your flight departure time

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 9-Day Greece Tour Package?
faqs.a: The 9-Day Greece Tour Package covers Athens, Naxos, Crete, and Santorini. You will explore Athens' ancient landmarks, discover the authentic Cycladic charm of Naxos, experience the rich history and culture of Crete, and enjoy Santorini's world-famous caldera views and spectacular sunsets. The tour runs for 8 nights and 9 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 9-Day Greece Tour Package cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,995 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, two domestic flights, speed ferry tickets, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, and all airport, hotel, and port transfers specified in the itinerary. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel availability.

faqs.q: Are domestic flights and ferry tickets included in this itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes two domestic flights and all required speed ferry tickets between destinations. These transportation arrangements make it easy and convenient to travel between Athens and the Greek islands.

faqs.q: Are international flights included in the package?
faqs.a: No, international flights are not included in the tour price. Travelers are responsible for arranging their own flights to and from Greece. Magnificent Travel can assist with travel planning and recommendations if needed.

faqs.q: Does the 9-day Greece tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guides provide historical insights, cultural information, and local expertise throughout the journey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Greece?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors looking for a combination of history, culture, authentic island life, and spectacular scenery. It offers a well-balanced introduction to both mainland Greece and some of the country's most beautiful islands.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, ferry ports, island villages, and historic districts. Most travelers in average health can comfortably participate throughout the itinerary

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Naxos, Crete, and Santorini?
faqs.a: Naxos is known for its traditional villages, beautiful beaches, and authentic Greek atmosphere. Crete offers impressive archaeological sites, local culture, and diverse landscapes. Santorini is famous for its volcanic caldera, whitewashed villages, blue-domed churches, and unforgettable sunsets overlooking the Aegean Sea.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 9-Day Greece Tour Package?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, transportation conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 9-Day Greece Tour Package available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: The tour operates throughout the year, subject to seasonal ferry schedules and flight availability. You can extend your stay in Athens, Naxos, Crete, or Santorini, upgrade hotel categories, add optional excursions, or modify the itinerary according to your preferences. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
